task.title: How to design an External Action

step.cmd: Create a Visual Studio Class Library Project. The X-Author client installer includes a sample C# file.

info.p: The code sample shows the functions to use and it will pop up a message box in runtime. You can extend the Execute() function to write your custom logic using the full power of Visual Studio and .NET.

step.cmd: Add a reference of the Apttus.XAuthor.ExtensionLib module into the project. The Apttus.XAuthor.ExtensionLib action class which represents an action is available for external use in this SDK Library. Any user who designs a new action, needs to add a reference of this library in their Visual Studio project. This library extends the following:

ul.li: Action Class extends the capabilities of the Base class capabilities to the custom .cs file.
IActionRuntime interface invokes the execute method defined in a custom .cs file.

step.cmd: Provide Name and Type for the external action and provide custom logic for the Execute() function.
Compile and link the assembly to generate the output .NET assembly. The .NET assembly should be a.dll file.

note.p: The sample *.cs file can contain one or more external actions.
